content: Hi how can i assist you today
My phone suggests calling a friend the exact moment I think about them. It feels like it senses the thought.
Contact suggestions often weigh recency, frequency, and time-of-day habits. Was it around a time you usually talk to that friend?
Yes, most Tuesdays around 7 p.m., but I hadn’t messaged yet.
A weekly cadence can prompt that card even without a same-day text. Were there calendar events or location patterns linked to those evenings?
We meet after my gym class; I was near the gym.
Location plus routine could explain the timing. On weeks when the gym plan changes, does the suggestion appear less?
When I skip the class, it rarely pops up.
That contrast points to routine signals rather than thought-reading.
